items.title: Producing the classical axioms of a Weil cohomology theory from a monoidal functor on motives
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter weil.tex (Weil Cohomology Theories)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that over an algebraically closed field a rational linear monoidal functor from motives to graded vector spaces whose value on the twist is concentrated in degree minus two produces data (D1), (D2) and (D3) satisfying all the axioms of a Weil cohomology theory except possibly two parts of the duality axiom (statement lines 1857-1866). The proof (proof lines 1867-2027) constructs the algebra, the cycle class map and the degree map and verifies the axioms through duality of motives, monoidality and correspondences. H3: a long construction with an axiom by axiom verification, written out in full.
